In this task, you will be asked to identify pictures. You will be shown a picture gradually with a word listed below it, just like in the example above. Your job is to rate whether you think the word accurately describes what the full picture will be.

Practice using your index and middle fingers to move your rating up and down the scale. You can make your rating at any point along the scale, depending on how confident you are in your response.

Once you respond, more of the picture will begin to appear. Reconsider the rating you made. You may change your rating as much or as little as you like. Once you make your second response, you will see the full picture and the correct word.

You will now complete several practice trials before beginning the experiment. Try to respond as quickly as you can.
